AboutTabs.004 In 2010, Samnang began personally su: In 2010, Samnang began personally supporting 45 children at an orphanage in Takeo Province, Cambodia. It was not easy, but he believed every child deserved care, education, and a chance for a better future.
AboutTabs.005 Samnang shared the work on Facebook,: Samnang shared the work on Facebook, hoping others would see the children's needs and join. Dr. Joseph from the United States was the first person to contact the team. He came to Cambodia and personally supported the children. His kindness and compassion became an important part of the journey.
AboutTabs.006 Today, those 45 children have grown: Today, those 45 children have grown up. Many are studying at university and some have graduated. To honor Dr. Joseph's contribution, Samnang established the name
AboutTabs.009 Helping Children. Building Hope. Cha: Helping Children. Building Hope. Changing Lives.
AboutTabs.012 We are a team working together to su: We are a team working together to support children and communities in Cambodia. Leadership, fundraising, administration, technology, and daily care come together to keep our projects responsible and effective.
AboutTabs.014 To support children and communities: To support children and communities in need through education, food, care, and meaningful opportunities for a better future.
AboutTabs.016 A caring and supportive Cambodia whe: A caring and supportive Cambodia where every child can learn, grow, and live with hope and dignity.
